chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Opportunity identification involves recognizing unmet needs, problems, trends or resource combinations that can support a venture.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Innovation is implementation of new or significantly improved products, processes, methods or organizational approaches.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Idea screening evaluates business ideas against criteria such as market need, feasibility, resources and strategic fit.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: A business model explains how an organization creates, delivers and captures value.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: A business plan describes the venture, market, operations, strategy, organization and financial expectations.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Feasibility analysis evaluates whether a proposed venture is viable from technical, market, financial and other perspectives.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Technical feasibility assesses whether required technology, facilities, processes and capabilities are available or attainable.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Market feasibility evaluates customer demand, competition, market size and commercial potential.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Financial feasibility evaluates investment needs, revenues, costs, cash flows, profitability and financial risk.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: MSMEs are enterprises categorized under India's applicable legal framework based on prescribed investment and turnover criteria.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Government support may include credit facilitation, training, technology support, infrastructure, market access and policy measures.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Industrial sickness may result from persistent financial, operational, managerial, technological or market problems.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Rehabilitation seeks to restore viable distressed units through appropriate financial, managerial, technological or organizational measures.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Institutional finance includes funding from organized financial institutions for business and entrepreneurial activity.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Commercial banks provide entrepreneurs with credit and related financial services subject to eligibility and risk assessment.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Cooperative Banks is a standard management topic covered through its core concepts, principles, applications and decision-making implications.

chapters.unit: Unit X — Entrepreneurship Development and Small Business
chapters.answer: Microfinance provides small-scale financial services, especially to underserved or low-income clients.
